record_audits.database_free_text_activity: Anti-Gram+ & Gram-, Antifungal, candidacidal, Antiparasitic, Antimalarial
record_audits.database_comments: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (89.3%) to Dermaseptin-LI1. Activity: Active against E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 2.68 uM), S. aureus ATCC 25923 (MIC 2.68 uM), K. pneumoniae (MIC 10.7 uM) and C. albicans (MIC 10.7 uM). Parasites: P. falciparum NF54 (IC50 12.06 uM) or TM90C2B (IC50 15.34 uM), L. Mexicana (IC50 0.61 uM) ( Proaño-Bolaños et al., 2024. Updated 7/2024
record_audits.review_notes: APD6 row is retained as linked database provenance with conflict context; only source-supported Table 2 values are promoted into final activity rows.
record_audits.conflict_context: APD6 free text includes primary Table 2 antibacterial values but may also contain updated or non-paper parasite activity annotations; preserve conflict instead of treating all text as 2019 primary evidence.

record_audits.database_comments: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (95%) to Phylloseptin-1. Note that the last residue G in Phyloseptin-S1 is converted to amide in Phylloseptin-1 from a different species. Thus, these two peptides are essentially the same as can be seen from the similar activity spectrum. Activity: Active against E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 70 uM) and S. aureus ATCC 25923 (MIC 6.3 uM).
record_audits.review_notes: APD6 row is retained as linked database provenance with conflict context; only source-supported Table 2 values are promoted into final activity rows.
record_audits.conflict_context: APD6 AP03215 maps to Phyloseptin-S1 comparator text; the primary paper uses it as an external/comparison row and separately reports Phyloseptin-SP1.

caution_summary.finding: Primary Table 1/2 reports -NH2 for the novel SP peptides; local APD6/DBAASP sequence fields store letters only.
Dermaseptin-B4, Dermaseptin-S1, and Phyloseptin-S1 rows in Table 2 are comparator/external-reference rows and are not treated as new clean primary assays.
Hemolysis exact percentages are linked database rows anchored to primary Figure 5; local primary XML does not tabulate numeric curve values.
APD6 free text can mix this paper values with later or comparator annotations; only source-supported Table 2 values are promoted.
